auth.registerSubtitle: Start with your personal style profile
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.eligibilityNote: The service is open to women in the UAE. We ask so we can confirm you are eligible.

validation.dateInvalid: Enter your date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD.

errors.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.validation_error: Please check the details you entered.
errors.unexpected_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

assessment.selfAssessed: Based on your own answers. This is not an expert assessment.
assessment.photoOption: Prefer to use a photo? We can analyse one for an indicative result.

recommendations.empty: Complete an assessment to get your recommendations.

photos.title: My photos
photos.intro: Add a clear, front-facing photo taken in daylight.
photos.consent: I agree to my photo being stored and processed to assess my style.
photos.consentRequired: Please agree before adding a photo.
photos.note: Automatic photo analysis is not available yet. Your photos are kept privately for your assessment.

reasons.not_an_image: The file is not a photo.
reasons.too_small: The photo is too small. Use a higher resolution.
reasons.too_blurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady.
reasons.too_dark: The photo is too dark. Move to better light.
reasons.too_bright: The photo is too bright. Avoid direct light.
reasons.no_face: No face was found. Face the camera directly.
reasons.face_too_small: Your face is too far away. Move closer.

analysis.intro: An automated, indicative reading of your photo. A consultant's assessment can confirm it.

tips.face: Face the camera in daylight, no filter, hair away from your face.
tips.full_body: Stand facing the camera, whole body in view, arms slightly away from your sides.

analysis.notAnalysable: We could not analyse this photo:
analysis.lowConfidence: This one was close between results. Try another photo or the questionnaire.
analysis.sampled: Colours we measured: skin, hair, eyes

reasons.multiple_faces: More than one face is in the photo.
reasons.face_badly_lit: Your face is too dark or too bright. Use soft daylight.
reasons.not_a_colour_photo: Use a colour photo without filters.
reasons.multiple_people: Only one person should be in the photo.
reasons.body_not_fully_visible: Your whole body, down to the knees at least, must be visible.
reasons.arms_not_down: Let your arms hang down, not on your hips.
reasons.arms_touching_body: Hold your arms slightly away from your sides.
reasons.silhouette_unclear: Stand against a plain background in good light.
reasons.hair_not_visible: Your hair is not visible in this photo.
reasons.clothes_not_visible: Your clothes are not visible enough.

intro.hair-colour: See a new hair colour on your own photo.
intro.outfit-colour: See your outfit in recommended colours.

disclaimer.hair-colour: Colour only. A new cut or style is not shown.
disclaimer.outfit-colour: Your own clothes in a new colour, not a different garment.
disclaimer.makeup: A simulation; real results depend on the artist and your skin.

status.ineligible: This service is not available for your account.

reasons.profile_incomplete: Date of birth, gender and country are needed.
reasons.under_minimum_age: You are under the minimum age.
reasons.country_not_available: We are not in your country yet.

identity.title: Identity verification
identity.explain: Needed before booking or messaging a stylist. Upload your Emirates ID (front, then back). It is deleted after review.

retail.title: Shop your style
retail.intro: Pieces from retailers that match your results. You will leave the app to buy.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.redeemed: Done. You can use it when booking.

shop.title: Shop
shop.ordered: Thank you. Your order is placed.

stylists.title: Find a stylist
stylists.noLocation: Your location is not available. Search by city instead.

consultation.reportPending: Your stylist's report will appear here.
consultation.caption: Caption (optional)
consultation.consent: Photos you add are shared only with this stylist.

intake.personality: How you want to come across
intake.goals: What you want from your wardrobe

messages.title: Messages
messages.policy: Keep conversations in the app. Messages with phone numbers, emails, links or bank details are not delivered.

warning.contact_details_blocked: This message was not delivered because it contains contact or payment details.
warning.contact_details_flagged: This message contains contact details and has been flagged.

consequence.warning: This is a warning. Repeated attempts pause messaging.
consequence.suspended: Messaging is paused on your account for now.

application.title: Become a stylist
application.addCredential: Add a photo of the document

status.rejected: Not approved. You can update and resubmit.

intro.garment: Pick a piece and see it on your full-length photo.
intro.hairstyle: Pick a cut and style and see it on your face photo.

tryOn.keepColour: Colour (optional; leave empty to keep the style's colour)

disclaimer.garment: A fitted picture of the piece, not how it will drape on you. What you are wearing may show around it.
disclaimer.hairstyle: A preview. It looks most natural when the new style covers at least as much as your current hair.

services_admin.title: Services and availability
services_admin.name: Name
services_admin.fill: Choose a service and enter a name and price.
services_admin.badTimes: Enter the date as YYYY-MM-DD and times as HH:MM, separated by commas.

report.delivered: Delivered. The client can now read it.

workspace.title: Colour workspace
workspace.noPhoto: The client has not shared a face photo yet.
workspace.openExplain: Opening the workspace for a new client uses credits.
workspace.readingNote: Indicative, a starting point for your own assessment.

featured.title: Be featured
featured.intro: Appear at the top of stylist search. An administrator reviews each placement before it starts.
